env.service: UNMAPPED_SERVICE_TEST=1 bun run service -- --port 8799 --data $SCR/service-data --browser-origin http://localhost:5192 (a fresh empty dir; restarted on the same dir between parts)
env.page: bunx vite --config $SCR/vite.e2e.config.mts, run inside $SCR/snap: `git archive origin/main` (e0710c6) plus this run's files, node_modules symlinked, no watcher, no HMR, a private Vite cacheDir; http://localhost:5192 with the dev CSP that allows loopback
env.world: bun --tsconfig-override tsconfig.node.json scripts/seed-shared-world.ts make --service ws://127.0.0.1:8799 --out $SCR/seed → __INVITE__; later … remove --out $SCR/seed --key <the phone's key>
env.driver: CDP_PORT=9344 bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(sed 's|__INVITE__|<link, & escaped>|; s|__SHOTS__|<dir>|g' <run file>)"
env.viewport: 375 × 812, deviceScaleFactor 2, mobile with touch emulation (each run starts with {viewport})
env.input: touch only (tap, tapText) and text typed into the focused field. Evals read the page text, window.seed.world.read/badges and IndexedDB; some evals navigate (reload; park the page on /sw.js while the owner removes the key, then open it again), and one calls window.seed.world.append directly with crypto.subtle.sign counted, as a draft that bypasses the composer.

part: RM-3 — the service is back and the owner has removed the phone's key; the phone opens the page again and reconnects

actions.eval: (async () => { const b = await window.seed.world.badges(); const id = b.value[0].worldId; const r = await window.seed.world.read(id); const s = r.value.status; return JSON.stringify({link: s.link, role: s.role, writable: s.writable, head: s.head.n, pending: s.pending, refused: s.refused, error: s.error && s.error.code, me: s.me, pendingTexts: r.value.pending.map((p) => p.event.body.text ?? p.event.kind), refusedList: r.value.refused.map((x) => [x.event.body.text ?? x.event.kind, x.error.code])}); })()

new Promise((resolve) => { const open = indexedDB.open('unmapped-browser'); open.onsuccess = () => { const db = open.result; const tx = db.transaction(['worlds', 'entries', 'outbox'], 'readonly'); const out = {}; const w = tx.objectStore('worlds').getAll(); w.onsuccess = () => { out.worlds = w.result.map((r) => ({refused: r.refused.map((x) => [x.event.kind, x.event.body.text ?? null, x.error.code]), removed: r.removed === undefined ? 'absent' : r.removed && r.removed.code})); }; const e = tx.objectStore('entries').count(); e.onsuccess = () => { out.entries = e.result; }; const o = tx.objectStore('outbox').getAll(); o.onsuccess = () => { out.outbox = o.result.map((r) => r.events.map((ev) => ev.body.text ?? ev.kind)); }; tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(JSON.stringify(out)); }; open.onerror = () => resolve('no db'); })

JSON.stringify({lines: document.body.innerText.split('\n').filter((l) => /member|removed|refused|Refused|waiting|read this world|Leave the note|before the owner|note ·/.test(l)), sendOffered: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some((b) => b.textContent === 'Leave the note')})

(async () => { const b = await window.seed.world.badges(); const id = b.value[0].worldId; const r = await window.seed.world.read(id); const s = r.value.status; const subtle = crypto.subtle; const real = subtle.sign; let signed = 0; subtle.sign = function (...args) { signed += 1; return real.apply(this, args); }; let out; try { out = await window.seed.world.append(id, {kind: 'note', seen: s.head.n, body: {coord: {cx: 0, cz: 0, x: 9, z: 9}, anchors: [], text: 'A note after the owner removed this key.', contests: null, name: 'Rin'}}); } finally { delete subtle.sign; } return JSON.stringify({signed, result: out.ok ? {ok: true, id: out.value.id, n: out.value.n} : {ok: false, code: out.error.code, message: out.error.message}}); })()
